tomato.name: Tomato
tomato.description: A warm-season fruit, rich in lycopene and vitamin C.
tomato.how_to_find: Grows best in full sun, well-drained soil.

zucchini.name: Zucchini
zucchini.description: A summer squash, high in water and fiber.
zucchini.how_to_find: Thrives in warm weather with regular watering.

chicken.name: Chicken
chicken.description: A versatile poultry, source of lean protein.
chicken.how_to_find: Available from local farms or markets.

porcini.name: Porcini Mushroom
porcini.description: A prized wild mushroom, earthy and rich.
porcini.how_to_find: Grows near oak, chestnut, and pine trees in autumn.

asparagus.name: Asparagus
asparagus.description: The first green shoots of the year, tender and mineral.
asparagus.how_to_find: Cut young spears in early spring; snaps where it bends.

lamb.name: Spring Lamb
lamb.description: Young lamb — the traditional spring meat of the pastures.
lamb.how_to_find: Ask your butcher for local spring lamb in early season.

strawberry.name: Strawberry
strawberry.description: The first sweet fruit of the turning year.
strawberry.how_to_find: Ripens low to the ground; pick when fully red.

elderflower.name: Elderflower
elderflower.description: Creamy-white spring blossoms with a heady perfume.
elderflower.how_to_find: Hedges and woodland edges; harvest dry mornings.

honey.name: Honey
honey.description: The bees' gift — the sweet of the flowering months.
honey.how_to_find: Local apiaries sell the true flavour of your region.

chanterelle.name: Chanterelle
chanterelle.description: Golden forest mushroom with a fruity, apricot scent.
chanterelle.how_to_find: Mossy forest floors under oak and beech after rain.

pomegranate.name: Pomegranate
pomegranate.description: The winter jewel of the old orchards — seeds like rubies.
pomegranate.how_to_find: In season in late autumn and winter; heavy = juicy.

citrus.name: Citrus
citrus.description: Oranges, lemons, and grapefruit — the sun held through winter.
citrus.how_to_find: Sunny southern regions; thin skin and heft mean juice.

venison.name: Venison
venison.description: Lean, dark game from the winter forest.
venison.how_to_find: Game season; ask local hunters or farms.

summer_solstice.name: Summer Solstice Festival
summer_solstice.description: Celebration of the longest day, fire, and abundance.

harvest_moon.name: Harvest Moon Festival
harvest_moon.description: Gratitude for the harvest, community gathering.

first_green.name: First Green Festival
first_green.description: The first green return — planting, blessing, and cleaning.

midsummer_fire.name: Midsummer Fire
midsummer_fire.description: Bonfires on the longest evenings, light kept through the dark.

winter_lights.name: Winter Lights
winter_lights.description: Candles against the dark — the festival of returning light.
